name: qualify-oe
decision_rule: The checks of the four oe-* scenarios qualify when, in every scenario, each good* arm passes and every other arm fails, and each failing arm fails on the checks its script's first line names and no others: wrong*, the correctness checks; bad*, the checks for what it adds or leaves out; adv*, the one check it targets. good-redundant-regex passes with new_regex_defined true. A reference exists in the scenarios whose qualify/ directory has its script; in the others the arm leaves the tree unchanged, as noop does, and fails there without meaning anything. Read the per-run check values, not only the pass flags.
